name: Mitts
summary: Mitts turns the floor of your room into a stickhandling gym. Put a real puck on the floor, pick up your stick, and the headset watches the puck through passthrough while gates, targets and pucks to dodge appear around it. Drills: Random Gates, Figure Eight, Dodge, Weave and Dribble. Moves, Chip and Tight Space are coming soon. Every drill has its own options (size, direction, which hand) and a difficulty from 1 to 10. Heads-up, average puck speed and top puck speed are measured on every run and never change
